'''Symoxin''' was a fairly common<ref name="Traumatize">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|cardname=Traumatize}}</ref> contact painkiller.<ref name="EGWT" /> In concentrated doses,<ref name="Traumatize" /> the drug could render a target unconscious within fifteen [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="EGWT" /> It was commonly used as a knock-out [[Poison/Legends|poison]], perfect for use with [[Dart/Legends|dart]] launchers or other weapons.<ref name="AE">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
